query:
SELECT p.execution_id,p.audience AS hostname,
            to_char(p.expires_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"') AS "expires_at!",
            (SELECT count(*) FROM approval_calls c WHERE c.pause_id=p.pause_id AND c.decision IS NULL) AS "pending!"
            FROM paused_runs p JOIN executions e ON e.id=p.execution_id WHERE e.status='paused' AND p.expires_at>now() ORDER BY e.started_at DESC,p.execution_id LIMIT 64
